occurrences.text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
